html:
Bauxite, the ore of aluminium, of which Guinea holds the largest known reserves in the world, mined on a large scale from the 1960s around Fria, Kindia and Boke.

An alumina plant opened at Fria in 1960, and big mines at Sangaredi near Boke began shipping ore in the early 1970s through the port of Kamsar. Bauxite became most of Guinea's export earnings under Sekou Toure and after, but it brought few jobs and much pollution and land loss to farmers. Since the 2010s Chinese-backed mines have made Guinea one of the largest exporters on earth, mostly to China. Its money and contracts are central to every Guinean government, from Conte to Alpha Conde.
sum: Bauxite, the ore of aluminium, of which Guinea holds the largest known reserves in the world, mined on a large scale from the 1960s around Fria, Kindia and Boke.
